entities.summary: Peru-Bolivia Confederation, a political institution in Peru during Independence: San Martín, Bolívar, and the Birth of the Republic (1826–1845). Grew from Bolívar governs Peru — 1824 and Battle of Ayacucho — December 9, 1824, ends Spanish rule in South America. Led to the emergence of Caudillo Era and the Early Republic.
